sentences.en: ‘With the eaves extending out on all sides like balancing poles,’ says Mr Ishida, ‘the building responds to even the most powerful jolt of an earthquake with a graceful swaying, never an abrupt shaking.’ Here again, Japanese master builders of a thousand years ago anticipated concepts of modern structural engineering.
sentences.zh: 石田先生说,“随着冰叶像平衡杆一样在四面四面延伸,建筑对即使是震动中最强大的震动也作出反应,震动优雅,从未突然震动。 ”在这里,日本建筑师一千年前就预见到现代结构工程的概念。
